sentences.text: Sk. Safiul & Ors vs Unknown on 13 August, 2024

Author: Suvra Ghosh
Bench: Suvra Ghosh
13.08.2024 rc/ct.no.34 Item No.145 Crr No.2659 of 2024 In the matter of : Sk. Safiul & Ors.
.......Petitioners Mr. Anindya Sundar Das Mr. Soumyajit Das Mahapatra Ms. Paramita Mondal Ms.
Kuheli Gayen ...for the Petitioners
On the prayer of the petitioners liberty is granted to the petitioners to correct the cause title of the application.

The petitioners have assailed the order passed by the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Contai on June 02, 2020 in G.R.Case No. 982 of 2018 whereby the learned Magistrate has taken cognizance of the charge sheet, and subsequent orders passed by the learned Magistrate.
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that though charge sheet has been submitted against the 1 st petitioner under Section 417/376/323/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code and against the other petitioners under Sections 323/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code the learned Magistrate has taken cognizance of offence punishable under Sections 417/376/323/506/34 of the Code against all the petitioners/accused.
It appears from the material on record that the petitioners have been able to make out an arguable case.
The petitioners are directed to serve copy of the application along with annexure thereto upon the opposite parties and file affidavit of service on the adjourned date.
Let this matter appear under the heading "Contested Application" in the monthly list of November,2024.

Further proceedings G.R.Case No. 982 of 2018 pending before learned Additional District and Sessions Judge, 2 nd Court, Contai, Purba Medinipur be stayed till November 30, 2024 or until further orders, whichever is earlier.
